meta.purpose: Cards rejected on CONTENT grounds — they render fine, but must never be posted. Read by scripts/generate-schedule.ts, which excludes every card_id here from every future week's draw. Hand-maintained: add an entry, with a reason, in the same commit that rejects the card. This is NOT render-exclusions.json, which is renderer-derived, regenerated wholesale, and means 'cannot be rendered'. See scripts/lib/rejections.ts.

wall.reason: Landing line 'A boy was raised in Plato's household.' is the opening of an anecdote, not a payoff — on screen, alone, with no surrounding passage, it says nothing. The pool's own rubric scores it 4 and calls it 'self-contained', which is why the scorer cannot be relied on to catch this class of line; it is a human judgment.
